task.title: Measure the complete all-options origin-to-project mapping query
task.problem: Search-phase experiments omit graph loading per option set, cache checks and output volume. They cannot show which change helps the actual element/project mapping.
task.proposal: Run paired line and filename-only searches on a pinned fetched project with representative options, origin and JSON. Keep correctness captures separate from wall-time measurements.
acceptance: Record target, pattern, option-space dimensions, versions, job count and cache conditions; compare at least three timed runs per mode with the same output sink. Report wall, first record, project load, cache checks, search, peak tool RSS, option sets, files/blobs and result counts.

Compare exit statuses and sorted distinct nonempty element/Gerrit-project pairs for complete runs, including a submodule when available. Record partial or unavailable runs as such. Publish only aggregate data or public fixtures.
Use the largest measured end-to-end cost to select the next task; recommend -l for pair extraction only when pair sets agree.
evidence: One shared blob at eight paths produced eight filenames or 128,000 matching lines in the search-only fixture. See https://github.com/rmorozov/bst-utilities/pull/17#pullrequestreview-6013606582 and docs/source-grep-performance.md.
